title: Recording, mixing: Baby’s Request, Cage, Getting Closer by Wings | 1978
content:
Studio Two, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producers: Paul McCartney, Chris Thomas

Wings continued work on three songs for the Back To The Egg album on 17 October 1978: ‘Baby’s Request’, the unreleased ‘Cage’, and ‘Getting Closer’.

The basic track of ‘Baby’s Request’ featured Paul McCartney on upright bass, Denny Laine on piano, Laurence Juber on Gibson ES 335 electric guitar, and Steve Holley playing drums with brushes.

Wings then resumed work on ‘Cage’, which had two discrete sections: ‘Emotional Moments’ and ‘He Didn’t Mean It’. The song was considered complete at the end of the session.

The recording of ‘Getting Closer’ began with McCartney on electric guitar, Laine and Juber on acoustic guitars, Linda McCartney on organ, and Holley on drums. Juber and Laine then overdubbed electric guitar parts, Paul added bass guitar and Mellotron, and Laine sang the lead vocals to complete the recording.

Wings then jammed a piece of music known as ‘Space Jam’, and rough mixes were made of ‘Cage’ and ‘Getting Closer’.
